notes.title: Newsletter #39 — February 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/ec8bf09a278bb5509b1ffb253722afb34af68300.jpg[/img]

Hey People!

How was your day? We have some news for you guys, I hope you will like it. 

[h2]What we’ve been up to?[/h2]
We are thrilled to announce the release of a big patch for the End of Lines! Countless hours of effort, passion, and dedication have gone into enhancing this experience, and we can’t wait for you to explore it. So, what’s new? 
[list]
[*] We made some balancing with variables so that branches specific to Nora are easier to unlock.
[*] Your balance of resources will have a more significant impact on certain events.
[*] Managing expeditions during camping will also have more impact.
[*] New images and texts for one of our epilogues have been added.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658960/End_of_Lines/

We’ve also decided to reopen the demo. If you play it, you'll be able to save your progress for the final version of End of Lines!

Don’t hesitate to share your opinion or critique with us so we can improve our game in the future.

[h2]The Storyteller’s Festival[/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that The Storyteller’s Festival has selected us and our game, End of Lines, for their 2025 lineup!

We feel truly honored and are so grateful for the chance to participate in a festival that highlights the magic of storytelling, creativity, and innovation in games. A heartfelt thank you goes out to the festival organisers for believing in our work!

To celebrate that, both End of Lines and its soundtrack are -50% off on Steam! Be sure to check out Two Half Studios to learn more about the festival and its amazing selection of games.

Check out the Steam page for the Steam Sale here:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival2025

[h2]BlueSky[/h2]
We are on BlueSky! Given the current political situation, we have decided to gradually move away from Twitter and explore new platforms. BlueSky is an exciting new space for us, one that better aligns with our values of open conversation and community-driven engagement.

Change can be tough, yet we believe this shift will enable us to connect more meaningfully and positively, just like we did on Mastodon (feel free to join us there too!). While we will remain on Twitter for a bit longer, we invite you to embark on this new journey with us!

[h2]Q&A[/h2]
We’re excited to announce that we’ll be hosting a Q&A session on our Discord on February 21 at 9 p.m. Paris time (CEST)! 

This is your chance to ask us anything about our work, including:
[list]
[*] [b]The production process[/b] – Behind-the-scenes insights into how we bring our games to life.
[*] [b]End of Lines[/b] – Dive deeper into the story, themes, and development of our game.
[*] [b]The demo[/b] – Have questions or feedback? Let’s talk about it!!
[/list]
We’d love to hear your thoughts, answer your burning questions, and chat with you in real-time! Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with the team and fellow community members. You can already ask your questions on the text channel "ask the devs" so we can answer them on the day of the event!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/bf5691ef07bed93c4e89ea41db6939f16e404602.jpg[/img]

And in the meantime, all our games are available here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

I hope you guys are doing well. Thank you for following us on this adventure. 

Best,

Ophélie,

notes.title: Newsletter #38 — January 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/65f1d2261465d4ffa25756e53fa1338f149eb427.jpg[/img]

Hey People!

We’re back!! Did you miss us? How were your holidays? As for us, we took a little break for this period, so it’s good to get back to our co-working space. We do have some updates for you guys.

[h2]What we’ve been up to?[/h2]
So, we have almost finished the first beta of our new game’s first chapter! It’s a long and meticulous process but, nonetheless, important. We want to offer you the best experience for our game. Our musicians, Camille Marcos and Julien Ponsoda, have also started working on the music for the game and, it sounds amazing!!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PgKn33uIopM

[h2]Discord Server? Already?[/h2]
Yeah, you heard it. Our server is out!! It seems I have overcome my difficulties with Discord. So, what can you find on it? Well, first of all, you can find us! You have a channel where you can ask us anything about the lore of our game or the production and the technique behind it. You also have channels where you can test your voice-acting skills with others, listen to music, discuss theories about the games, share memes, and share your art!! We want the community to interact with each other in a fun and safe space. We’re also very curious to see your creativity. It’s not perfect, but it’s working. So don’t hold back and join us!!

[url=https://discord.gg/tUcpYEnK]Join us on Discord![/url]

If you have some recommendations about the server don’t hesitate to message us!

And in the meantime,[i] Seers Isle[/i], [i]Along the Edge[/i], and [i]Across the Grooves[/i] and [i]End of Lines[/i] are available here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

Best,

Ophélie,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #36 — October 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/737b2173149cde36e03487c552365877b7a5a5ac.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

As usual, we’ve missed quite a few monthly newsletters (sorry… you should be used to that by now). But there is some new stuff coming around for you guys!

[h2]New Intern![/h2]

Hi everyone, I’m the new intern at Nova-Box! My name is Ophélie, and I will be the one writing to you from now on. I'm thrilled to be joining the team and bringing something new to our communications. You’ll be seeing more of me around the New Year!

[h2]What's new with End of Lines?[/h2]

So what’s happening with End of Lines? The avid readers of our newsletters are already aware of the challenges we've faced putting our game out there, in the public eye. Well, Nico and the team are putting together some [b]brand-new content[/b] for you guys! I can’t reveal any details just yet, but you can expect more information around December/January.

We’ve also decided to [b]reopen our demo[/b] in the coming months. Steam seems to boost games with demos through its algorithm, and we're hoping it will have a similar effect on our game. If you play it, you'll be able to save your progress for the final version of End of Lines!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658960/End_of_Lines/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/7435bbdb933e51ef674349e4321ceab95ed928d2.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What have we been up to?[/b][/h2]

The start of the autumn term means welcome back to our co-working space in Bordeaux. We were thrilled to catch up with our friends from other studios after some well-deserved reconnecting with Mother Nature. As you can imagine, when we’re not taking care of our one-year-old baby (End of Lines), we’re in full creation mode with our next game or we're attending events.

[h2]HORIZON(S), Bordeaux Videogames Forum![/h2]

Our writer, Geoffroy, was invited to participate in a roundtable discussion on how to manage the transition between different projects at HORIZON(S), a two-day event for game industry decision-makers. He was with Sabrina Alessandri of [url=https://www.towerfive.com/][i]Tower Five[/i][/url] from La Rochelle and David Duriot of [url=https://www.lapoulenoire.fr/][i]LA POULE NOIRE[/i][/url] from Angoulême.

Now the question is, how does this relate to our studio? Well, you see, we have two creative directors, Geoffroy and Nico, who switch roles for each new project. For instance, Nico served as the creative director for End of Lines, while Geoffroy is currently leading our new project. This means we have shorter waiting times between productions, allowing for a smoother transition and providing our studio with greater artistic diversity.

[h2]To Hell With the Ugly[/h2]

To Hell With the Ugly is a point-and-click adventure game based on the novel of the same name by Boris Vian. You play Rock Bailey, a young man who's strikingly handsome and rather shallow, who gets kidnapped after leaving a jazz club. Navigate through bar brawls and a police investigation to assist Rocky…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455450/To_Hell_With_The_Ugly/

[h2]Empire of the Ants[/h2]

Empire of the Ants set out on an epic adventure into the microscopic world in this photorealistic strategy game. Play as a brave ant and lead your colony through the perils of the forest and its diverse wildlife.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287330/Empire_of_the_Ants/

[h2]The Six One Indie Showcase ![/h2]

Hey, if you're on our socials, you might have seen that we were in the alumni section of the [url=https://www.sixoneindie.com/][i]Six One Indie[/i][/url] Showcase! We thank them again for that selection.

[h2]Let's conclude with our usual exclusive artwork![/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/737b2173149cde36e03487c552365877b7a5a5ac.jpg[/img]

And in the meantime,[i] Seers Isle[/i], [i]Along the Edge[/i], and [i]Across the Grooves[/i] and [i]End of Lines[/i] are available here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

Best,

Ophélie,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #31 — December 2023
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/a7830b872344cb05b7a6a2ba0e55537ec6d9f79a.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Despite a very mild (and particularly rainy) month of December in Bordeaux, the Nova-box premises have quietly gone into winter mood as everyone prepares to join their loved ones for the end of the year. Desks and instruments have been prepared for this short (but necessary) period of hibernation.

[h2]Dreamhack Beyond Indies / Winter Sale[/h2]

We're delighted to announce that End of Lines was selected to be featured at the Dreamhack Beyond Indie 2023 Sales. This was a great opportunity to showcase our latest interactive graphic novel on Steam, from December 15th to 21st. End of Lines was on sale with 25% off for the occasion, but don't worry if you missed it since, right on the heels of this event, the Steam Winter Sale has just started.

It will be the last time you'll be able to get our titles at these attractive prices for a while. As always, there's our nifty "complete your collection" bundle for you to get an extra 10% off on our game you don't already own. The link is here below.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/f178dca75fc99ec9bd87f9cdd072e9d3af6611ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game Updates[/h2]

As you may have noticed, all Nova-box games have recently been updated. We've added support for “DualSense” controllers (PlayStation 5). We've also taken the opportunity to push some minor bug fixes to End of Lines and Across the Grooves. All of this is detailed in the most recent patch notes of each game.

[h2]Servers migration[/h2]

It's a bit technical and you won't notice any difference on your end since our games are fully offline experiences, but we're pretty proud that Nova-box development servers are now managed locally, thanks to our friends at Zaka Services, a small company in Bordeaux to whom we entrust our data management.


Zaka Services are very much aligned with us on carbon reduction and sobriety measures. For example, they only use refurbished hardware for their servers.

Here's a link to their website (in French): [url=https://www.zaka-services.com/]www.zaka-services.com[/url]

[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]

We're now fully committed to the pre-production of our next graphic novel, and can't wait to tell you all about it. We can't tell you much about it for now, but the story will revolve around a couple of iconic places. One of them is a strange cabaret tentatively called “The Outpost” (the name might change, but don't hesitate to tell us what you think of it).

Here's the first concept art of this whimsical albeit a tad creepy place.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/a7830b872344cb05b7a6a2ba0e55537ec6d9f79a.jpg[/img]


That’s all for now, and see you next month!

And in the meantime,[i] Seers Isle[/i], [i]Along the Edge[/i], and [i]Across the Grooves[/i] and [i]End of Lines[/i] are available here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

Best,

Nico,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/dd5420ce89545a2791f063781bed5fe094341fd7.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends,

here are the patch notes for v1.2.1 of Across the Grooves:
— Dual Sense controllers support. Your PlayStation 5 gamepads should now work correctly both via USB and Bluetooth.
— Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was disabled when playing on a touchscreen equipped Windows device,
— Fixed a music bug where the audio for the song sequence in chapter 1 would not start (big thanks to Steam users Grumpelstiltskin and Talae who helped us pinpoint the issue).

Please note that our Twitch integration beta has been disabled. Unfortunately, Twitch completely changed its token system, rendering the feature unusable for the time being.

If you're interested in Twitch integration, please reach out to us, we will consider devoting some of humble resources to make it work again if there's enough demand.

Thank you and kind regards,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #29 — October 2023
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/60876a75183d19c048afa7a029c389e8dd1258eb.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

This month, we're diving deep into the launch of End of Lines and its aftermath.

[h2]End of Lines is OUT![/h2]
Our latest interactive graphic novel was released on May 25th, 2023, just a few days after [i]Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom[/i], and at the very moment the press was receiving advance copies of [i]Street Fighter 6[/i] and [i]Diablo 4[/i] with only a few days for them to complete their reviews before their embargo was lifted (spoiler alert: it didn't go well for us).

But let's start with the good news: we've had some very good feedback. We'd like to thank everyone who has supported us despite all the big releases coming one right after another this year.

Here are a few samples of the reviews the game received over the web and in the press:

[list]
[*][i]"If you like visual novel-style games, don't pass up End of Lines. It's really great!"[/i], yunicia.fr (18/20),[/*]
[*][i]"Moving play of impressions, sublime in its sense of detail.",[/i] Les Inrockuptibles,[/*]
[*][i]"End of Lines is an experience that dares to carry a difficult theme perfectly suited to the visual novel theme."[/i], Canard PC (8/10),[/*]
[*][i]“I enjoyed End of Lines’ take on the consequences of neglecting the climate crisis, as shown via the intimate stories and daily struggles of individuals living those very consequences in the future. It’s a warning!”[/i], Switchaboo (7/10),[/*]
[*][i]“End of Lines gets down to the nitty-gritty, naming those responsible for a coming catastrophe and showing the ecological and human consequences in the clearest terms. The result leaves nobody unscathed, and is as unsettling for its climatic anxieties as for its human dramas.”[/i], The Pixel Post,[/*]
[*][i]"End of Lines is a remarkable game both in terms of storytelling and direction, taking on all the strengths of the developers' previous games."[/i], Loutre Perfide for veuillezparlapresente.com,[/*]
[*][i]“End of Lines brings us a new visual novel in which we get a glimpse at a potential future that can hit us if we don’t act on the effects of climate change and global warming before it’s too late.”[/i], PS4blog.net (9/10).[/*]
[/list]

A big "thanks" too to the content creators who helped give our humble creation greater visibility.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/40812cc9febdb1b66de63a16fcaa306107724b32.jpg[/img]

[h2]OK, shall we move on to the bad news?[/h2]
Despite the good feedback, as you can imagine, the release of [i]End of Lines[/i] was a bit of a disaster for the studio. The game was practically invisible on release and, as a result, to be honest, sales are clearly not up to expectations.

For example, the steam page has reached a plateau of 28 reviews over the past few weeks, which is very low. Even if the majority are positive, this is unfortunately not enough to sustain an indie game.

As a result, we've had to scale back our ambitions for future projects. We also had to (sadly) part ways with Julie, the wonderful artist who produced most of the backgrounds for End of Lines.

If you'd like to help us out, you can continue to spread the word about the game and share your opinion on the Steam page if you haven't already done so.

Naturally, we haven't given up at all. We're continuing to do our best to give End of Lines more visibility.

Our launch event at the [i]Librairie du Basilic[/i] bookshop gave us the opportunity to unveil the game with a glorious public reading by our partner Alix, co-author and proofreader of End of Lines.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/4c95da994bd03ab872f736b845ce0393dc804894.jpg[/img]

We hope to continue our collaboration with booksellers, thanks to a little booklet we've produced that we can leave on the shelves.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/4ac2c29eb78b96a139e75d08d846b7f8d4d6ceaa.jpg[/img]

If you are a bookseller, or know any booksellers who might be interested in this project, please write to us.

On the technical side, a patch is on its way to correct a few bugs and rebalance variables. We've noticed that certain junctions are rarer than they should be.

[h2]Social Media[/h2]
For reasons we won't go into here, but I'm sure you'll understand, we've decided to stop using the social network formerly known as Twitter for our studio communications. It's a difficult decision, as for several years this platform was our main tool for talking about our productions and for engaging with our community.

As a result, we'll be publishing our newsletters much more regularly. We'd be very grateful if you could pass on the subscription link to those who might be interested in our news.

To interact with us, you can find us here:
[list]
[*]on Mastodon: [url=https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@novabox]@novabox@mastodon.gamedev.place[/url][/*]
[*]or on Bluesky (the account is handled by Geoffroy): [url=https://bsky.app/profile/nova-box.com]@nova-box.com[/url][/*]
[*]and why not my personal toot box? [url=https://mastodon.art/@Nicofouque]@Nicofouque@mastodon.art[/url][/*]
[/list]

[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]
While we're going through the trials and tribulations of releasing End of Lines, we've started to work on at least two projects that we're sure to announce shortly. In the meantime, here's a mysterious concept for one of them (we're keeping the other one exclusive to the subscribers of this newsletter — so, please subscribe!).

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018731/8e21e4350c1231a17bffb400e8a362b9b44f145c.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, and see you next month! (we really mean it this time).

And in the meantime,[i] Seers Isle[/i], [i]Along the Edge[/i], and [i]Across the Grooves[/i] and [i]End of Lines[/i] are available here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

Best,

Nico,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #27 — December 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/b9dd489d509e81bd82c14fd31f40990ddb637856.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

First of all, we would like extend our best holiday wishes to all of you, dear readers.

In this month's issue, we're talking about the awards received at Indie X, our ongoing winter sale and the price adjustments that are coming up early next year.

As always, we'll finish with an update on End of Lines production, along with a new illustration from the game, so keep on scrolling!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/8a3c44db935d93bf13ad5793c3bee413f00b1be8.jpg[/img]

[h2]End of Lines won an award at Indie X 2022![/h2]

So, last month, we had the chance to take part in Indie X, the biggest indie games festival in Portugal, where End of Lines received a nomination for "[b]Best Art Direction[/b]" and won the award for "[b]Games for Good[/b]". We're very proud to have received both those distinctions.


And if you missed it, our IndieX livestream is available for replay on Youtube, where we go in depth into the artistic statement and game development of End of Lines. Big thanks to Patricia Casaca who was a wonderful host!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tWaHn6uI3RA


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/1ebafd124cfa647ca1bdf8f2541079af6ef10d6e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Price adjustments are coming in January[/h2]

Let's do the classic "I have good news and bad news" routine, shall we?

Let's get the "bad" news out of the way first: Steam adjusted the recommended prices conversion earlier this year, and we haven't applied them on our catalogue yet, but we're planning on doing it early next year, once the current Winter Sale ends. That means that the prices of our games will go up in certain regions.

Also, as you may have noticed, two-digits inflation has made a nasty comeback in Europe. That means each sale we make returns less value than it did in the past. To give you an example, if we only needed to sell six copies of Across the Grooves to pay for a kebab for each member of our team in the past (these are not real-life numbers, just an example), we will now need to sell seven or even eight copies of the game for same number of kebabs, because the price of kebabs went up with inflation, while the price of our games did not (yet).

That's why we're also planning on updating the base price of our games from 12.99€/$ to 13.99€/$ on Steam and other resellers. 

We know that this may seem like a very peculiar decision, but we really hope you'll understand why we're trying to approach things differently.

[h2]Winter Sales[/h2]

I can hear you asking me "okay, we get it" (and we really hope you do), "but what's the good news, then?"

Well, the good news is that we're making our the biggest discount to date on our full back catalogue, with 35% off on all our titles. So if you're on the fence about diving into a Nova-box game, now would be a great time to do so.

On top of that, you can get an extra 10% off with our permanent "complete your collection" bundle on Steam. Follow the nifty link here below, it will point you in the right direction:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15195/Novabox_Collection/

[h2]TL;DR[/h2]

So, to sum it up:
— the base price of our games will go up 1€/$ next month to counter inflation,
… but:
— we're currently running our biggest sale to date, with 35% off across the catalogue.

[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]

We're currently in the midst of our "friends & family" closed beta, and the first waves of feedback we've received are quite encouraging. We're very grateful to our testers for their time. Thanks to them we will have a lot of adjustments and improvements to implement into the game next month, once the beta session is concluded.

On the art side, Nico and Julie are still upgrading all the illustrations from placeholders to finished art pieces, and they will be doing that for the next couple of months, since there's a lot of images to behold in End of Lines (we've passed the 1000 visual assets for the first time, and by a good margin). All in all, we're still on track for an early-ish 2023 release, and we'll keep you posted once we know more, of course.

That’s all for now, see you next month!

Please consider adding [i]End of Lines[/i] to your wishlist if you haven't done so yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658960/End_of_Lines/

notes.title: Newsletter #24 — April 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/14dce91a0d9d4bb2c43e60d2e80d301a4b8db39b.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Do you remember that time when I promised you more frequent newsletters? Well, it turns out I skipped March, sorry about that. A classic case of "too much to do and too little time to do it", I'm afraid. I'll try to do better next month (but no promises).

Since last time, we've updated all our games to make sure they play great on the new Steam Deck device, and we've also made progress on End of Lines development (you'll get an update at the end of this newsletter, as always).

Also, we took part in a couple of events, online of course, but also IRL for a change!

 
[h2]Nova-box is Steam Deck ready[/h2]
If you own one of our games on Steam, you might have already seen the news pop up in your library's news feed: we've made all our catalog compatible with the device requirements for the Steam Deck..

We really believe this new handheld console is a great fit for our games, giving you another way to play them on the go or in the comfort of your favorite reading nook.

In terms of features, you won't see any big changes, as most of the upgrades took place under the hood. We took this opportunity to upgrade to the long term support version of Unity 2019 which should provide some optimizations. We also support the new "Dynamic Cloud Save" feature on Steam, which means saves are synchronized automatically over the internet whenever you put the Steam Deck to sleep, and synchronize back when it wakes up.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/5aa9d8af26fc839e4565807d488fffe53ba077fb.jpg[/img]
[i]Seers Isle running on the Steam Deck. Our other games play great as well.[/i]

 
[h2]End of Lines was featured in a pair of online events[/h2]
First, we took part in the "Earth Appreciation Day" Sale on Steam as an upcoming game. We were very glad to be part of this, alongside great ecologically aware titles. As you may imagine, it aligns with our ethos in general and with End of Lines in particular, and the fact that it helped our wishlists number is a nice cherry on the top.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/74d5bbf9e74a90807bf96df7dc3042e0a14ee2d2.jpg[/img]

End of Lines was also featured in the "Mini Indie Showcase" hosted by Six One Indie during the Pax East. You can watch the replay here below. There are some great upcoming titles to discover there too!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BdAq_B2eAjI

 
[h2]Demo at the Flora Tristan Library[/h2]
Our friend Leslie Tabourdeau invited us to talk about End of Lines at the Flora Tristan Library in Bordeaux a couple of weeks ago. We were, of course, happy to oblige. We hosted a demo session and talked about the game alongside a team of students from the Epitech computer school, who were working on a non-profit project with the aim to help detect and chart ocean pollution. It was a joy to have a chat with young professionals trying to make a difference. We wish them all the best in their future endeavors.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/7e3e5ac0656b9eb748429986f575a37382c3c9f2.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]
If you're wondering, yes, most of our attention has been focused on End of Lines. We're still late, but we managed to reduce our lateness quite a bit without crunching so far. Nico is currently working on an updated feedback system / iconography. If all goes well, you might see big cats on the top of the screen on the next iteration of the game.

Meanwhile, the rest of the text is progressing rapidly towards completion. Hopefully we'll have a first version by the end of the month. English translation and music/sound design just started too, and it's real a pleasure to see how Rachel, Camille and Julien were enthusiastic about the project and eager to start working on it!


That’s all for now, see you next month!

Please consider adding [i]End of Lines[/i] to your wishlist if you haven't done so yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1658960/End_of_Lines/

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

And if you want to hear from us more often, you can also follow us on social networks:
http://twitter.com/novabox
http://facebook.com/novabox.studio
https://instagram.com/novabox

Best,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Twitch Integration is now in open beta!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/62118353a2333c79a9380b5dbcc5deb3abe2c0a1.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is this Twitch chat feature?[/h2]
Our Twitch integration feature is now available in open beta for all streamers!

It allows the Twitch chat to interact with the game, allowing the [b]viewers to vote with chat commands[/b] each time a choice has to be made during the story.

To set it up, you'll need :
- the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nova-box]Steam[/url][/b] version of one our games,
- a [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/]Twitch.tv[/url][/b] account.
[h2]How to set it up[/h2]

Here are the instructions:
[h3]1. Update the game to Twitch beta:[/h3]
- Go to your [b]Steam Library[/b],
- [b]Right-click[/b] on the name of the game in the list, then choose “[b]properties[/b]”,
- Navigate to the “[b]betas[/b]” tab,
- Choose "[b]twitch[/b]" in the drop-down list,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/6afceddfbb8b0e8e109cf4310738f5fdedfec374.jpg[/img]

- Steam should then start updating the game to the beta version.

 
[h3]2. Link the game to your Twitch account:[/h3]
- Launch the game,
- Go to options, then click "[b]Configure[/b]" in the "[b]Twitch[/b]" section,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/a7b57191308e0444271116e195da10151afef546.jpg[/img]

- Under "User Name", enter your [b]Twitch username[/b],
- In the section "Token", click on "[b]Get[/b]",

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/6c14663e52ecc4eb978c6fb53691a1de76e9ccca.jpg[/img]

- [b]Your browser will open[/b], asking you to authorize our TwitchApp,
- Click on "[b]authorize[/b]",
- Your browser will now redirect you to the web page "nova-box.com/twitch",
- [b]Copy[/b] the token (it is a series of numbers and characters),

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/458f565b8003232e3411fbe5fa40a9ebfe4f5024.jpg[/img]

- Go back to the game, [b]paste the token in the token field[/b], click on "[b]connect[/b]",
- The "Disconnected" label should change to "[b]Connected![/b]",

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/1e50d15bf7b6c0e62d214fb47e6a70785e50dffe.jpg[/img]

- [b]Optional[/b]: You can set up the duration of the timer (the time given to the viewers to choose in chat) by changing the value of "Viewer choosing time". If you set it to "unlimited", you'll have to click the choices to progress in the game, otherwise, the most voted choice will be automatically selected at the end of the timer,

- When you go back to the main menu, a label indicating "[b]Connected to Twitch[/b]" should appear to the [b]top right corner[/b] of the screen,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/233ef81e862982254372b8b20cc4dd061e12d25b.jpg[/img]

- You can launch and [b]start a game normally[/b]. The game will now write the corresponding commands in the Twitch chat for each new choice. The most voted choice will be highlighted in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/df6b670a8bef4aa336d41300485085f02a721570.jpg[/img]
 
- Enjoy !

 
[h3]Notes[/h3]
- This feature is only available for the [b]Windows[/b] version of the game (not compatible with MacOS or Linux),
- [b]Chat commands[/b] for voting are either "[b]!choose <choice number>[/b]" or the shortcut "[b]!c <choice number>[/b]".
 
[h3]Special Thanks[/h3]
We would like to take this opportunity to express our gratitude to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/acexsoul]AceXSoul[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/funclej]FuncleJ[/url] for beta testing this feature and providing us with very detailed and helpful feedback.

Thank you! <3

notes.title: Newsletter #20 — Augsut 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/3d0fbc9b53112d08b95d4cb9093103a15c67e6df.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Geoffroy here, back on pen duty since Cyndie finished her internship at the end of July. I'd like to take this opportunity to thank her, on behalf of the team, for the wonderful work she's done for us, and I'm very happy to announce that she got recruited by our friends from Goblinz Studio and will be starting to work with them very soon. We wish her all the best for the future!

This month, we published our biggest patch yet for Along the Edge and Seers Isle. We also had a party and we have a couple of surprises coming up before the end of the year!


[h2]Seers Isle & Along the Edge: Version 2.0[/h2]
If you're a subscriber to this newsletter, you probably own at least one of our games, so chances are you already heard this piece of news through other channels: [b]earlier this month, we published a major update[/b] for both Seers Isle and Along the Edge.

I won't transcribe the whole list of patches here, but here's a few highlights:
- Along the Edge received an [b]extensive proofreading of the English version[/b] by Rachel, a [b]German fan-translation[/b] (thank you Kim!), and got a[b] full interface overhaul[/b] to make it on par with our later releases,
- we switched to the [b]Unity engine[/b] under the hood, which should greatly improve stability and performance, as well as providing a substantially [b]better support for Linux[/b],
- both games received a myriad of bug and typo fixes and several quality of life improvements.

Patch notes are available on the related game pages here on Steam (library and store), so head there if you want to skim through the full details. Also, please note that this upgrade [b]breaks the back-compatibility of save files[/b], but you still have the possibility of [b]going back to the previous version[/b] if you have a story to finish with your current save file (a step-by-step walkthrough on how to do so can be found in the patch notes).

 
[h2][b]Across the Grooves [/b][b]release party[/b][/h2]
[b][/b] 2020 has been quite a strange year so far, to say the least. We've been working remotely for the most part since mid-March, so [b]we couldn't properly celebrate[/b] the release of Across the Grooves when the game shipped. With the COVID situation still not resolved and the safety of everyone in mind, we decided not to go overboard. So, we did [b]throw a small party [/b]earlier this month.

Here's a picture of yours truly doing an impromptu speech in front of the team, courtesy of Charly Martin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/4f16237b9abbff74c0c015b250698af758d9a522.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]One more thing: Twitch integration[/h2]
I did tell you I had a couple of surprises coming up, didn't I?

These last few weeks, Daniel has been working on the Twitch API integration. What does it do? Well, imagine you're playing one of Nova-box's games live on Twitch and you would enjoy [b]including your viewers more[/b] in your storytelling and your decision-making during your live session: with this feature you can let them [b]vote in the chat[/b] (using a "!choose [x]" command), and either keep control on which dialog option to pursue or let your viewers take full control of the game by automatically choosing the most voted option at the end of a customizable timer.

Since a picture is worth a thousand words, here's what it looks like for Across the Grooves:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/4e6917e06d3562642e2b850ed455f8d737833990.jpg[/img]

The feature is [b]in beta[/b] right now, but we did a couple of test runs last week and it already works pretty well, so it should be available "soon™".

However, if you're a streamer and you'd be interested to [b]test this feature with your community[/b], we'll gladly send you a build and make improvements where needed based your feedback. Just send us an email at [b]contact@nova-box.com[/b] and we'll set this up with you!

Last but not least, please allow me tease you a little bit about what's in store for Seers Isle and Along the Edge. We have a [b]big announcement coming by the end of September![/b] I don't want to spoil the surprise, but keep your eyes peeled, because we'll have to "switch gears in order to maneuver in the port" (*wink* *wink*).

 

That’s all for now, see you next time!

If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

And if you want to hear from us more often, you can also follow us on social networks:
http://twitter.com/novabox
http://facebook.com/novabox.studio
https://instagram.com/novabox

Best,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #19 — July 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/c5100c7e7d7f368562561e8fc1fdb156ea953bfc.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Across the Grooves was released last month, and we are very happy with the positive feedback we have received.
It is time to keep you up to date with the latest news about the game and the studio!

[h2][b]What have we been up to?[/b][/h2]
Thanks to the [b]Indie Game Factory[/b]'s partnership with the [b]CCG expo[/b], visitors were able to play [b]Across the Grooves[/b] on a dedicated booth during the event which took place from July 16th to 20th in Shanghai.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/3722e25367641a8a2c4c2b29c4f1104a9e571875.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the Indie Game Factory for this opportunity!
 
[h2][b]Across the Grooves is available in South American Spanish[/b][/h2]
Good news for Spanish speakers: [b]the latest update is live[/b] and allows you to play the game in [b]South American Spanish[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/8a5dc48993db07d0eccc08bcc44ab3a863fa997e.jpg[/img]

This is a [b]fan translation[/b] by [b]Ariel Alejandro Muñoz[/b]. Thanks to him, more people will be able to enjoy the game across the world, so many thanks to him for his time and dedication!
 
[h2]More feedback on our game[/h2]
Since the release of the game, more reviews have been written.
Here is a selection of English press quotes:

“If you’re after a mature tale with interesting characters and solid writing, you may want to check this one out.” - Ollie Reynolds for [b]Nintendo Life[/b]
Full article [url=https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/switch-eshop/across_the_grooves]here[/url].

“Without exaggeration, I would recommend this game to anyone (any adult!) who is eager for a good story that could entertain for hours.” - Milaina Penzer for [b]Bonus stage[/b]
Full article [url=https://www.bonusstage.co.uk/2020/07/03/across-the-grooves-review/]here[/url].

“It has been a while since a game was able to take me somewhere the way this one does.” - Dillon Sickels for [b]FULLSYNC[/b]
Full article [url=https://fullsync.co.uk/across-the-grooves-review]here[/url].

“It’s definitely worth playing through for music nerds, time travel fanatics, and just fans of good stories.” - Niranjan Raju for [b]Gameffine[/b]
Full article [url=https://gameffine.com/across-the-grooves-review-pc-the-power-of-music-meets-time-travel/]here[/url].

Once again, many thanks to them for their kind words, encouragement and constructive criticism from all around the world!

[h2]Some news from our dev friends[/h2]
As you may know, we share our co-working space with our friends [b]Adrien and Maxime[/b] from [b]Studio Black Flag[/b] and [b]Loïc a.k.a Ukioq[/b].

Adrien and Maxime are still working on their upcoming game [u][b]Orphan Age[/b][/u] which is currently in alpha. It is a dystopian life sim game where you play not as the soldiers of war, but as the children left behind.

There is not a release date yet, but they are planning to release the game in [b]Early Access[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/23114188e22e128e364403997e11cd8aa557e328.jpg[/img]

As for Loïc, he’s still working on his first commercial video game, [u][b]Purple Noise Echo[/b][/u]. This is a tactical game with a dark neon ambiance in which you play [u]Node[/u], an amnesiac entity waking up in an unknown place made of hexagonal tiles.

The game is currently in [b]Early Access,[/b] but [b]all the features are in the game[/b], and [b]the lights and post-effects are much better[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/8bf2eeab4cd9d64419917bf96b181e281dbab0ea.jpg[/img]

For more info, please take a look at their [b]websites[/b]:
[list]

 	[*][url=https://purple-noise-echo.com/]Purple Noise Echo[/url][/*]
[/list]
 

That’s all for now! See you soon for the latest news about our games and our studio!

Cyndie,

[h2]A brand new fan-translation into South American Spanish![/h2]

We just updated the game with a complete fan-translation of all the texts into [b]South American Spanish[/b]!

Thanks to [b]Ariel Alejandro Muñoz[/b], from Chile, Across the Grooves is now available in this language.

We tried our best to check the quality of this translation, but with our limited resources and our limited access to native Spanish speakers, we couldn't perform a full proofreading. 

If you find a typo and want to help us, please send us an email at [b]contact@nova-box.com[/b] detailing the issue.

Alternatively, you can make a thread here on our Steam community forum, we'll monitor your posts.

Of course, we'll address all your feedback in a future update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/7dcd8295cc26ca1f818a26572b5662b98937bab2.jpg[/img]

Once again, big thanks to Ariel who made this update possible!
All the best to all of you, dear friends,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #18 — June 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/912780d1f08339ad75ca1e351b713f9ca78aa965.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Finally, that's it! [b]Across the Grooves[/b] has been in the wild since [b]June 17th[/b]!
This month, we tell you everything you need to know about the game!

[h2][b]Across the Grooves is out now[/b][/h2]
It's time to follow Alice's footsteps into parallel realities!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okU2NKPVtJY

[b]Across the Grooves[/b] is now available here on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957820/Across_the_Grooves/

If you like [b]the game’s soundtrack[/b], you can [url=https://nova-box.bandcamp.com/releases]preview the album[/url] on [b]Bandcamp[/b], or even [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15141/Game__Soundtrack/]get the bundle game + soundtrack[/url] on [b]Steam[/b]!

And since good news never comes alone, [b]the game's OST[/b] is also available on [b]streaming platforms[/b], such as Spotify or Deezer!

[h2]The first feedback on our game[/h2]
Amongst all Across the Grooves reviews, some have blown our minds. We had to share them with you!

Here’s a quote from Ross Keniston’s review for [b]The Finger Guns[/b].

[i]"Narrative driven video games have seen a real golden age this generation, now we can place Across The Grooves next to the likes of Everybody’s Gone to the Rapture, Gone Home and What Remains of Edith Finch as essential representations of a genre that constantly surprises me."[/i]

You can read the entire article [url=http://fingerguns.net/games/2020/06/11/across-the-grooves-review-memories-and-melodies/?fbclid=IwAR0HJ8zmOQhaJD6v1CtfVwaYd0uHPGYQnbs4K7zeUfQZAHqmqxI68jHCGTw]here[/url].

Also, [b]Get Indie Gaming[/b] made an excellent video review on his YouTube channel. You can watch it here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3C8e2LDsrr4
As for the gaming sites [b]WayTooManyGames[/b] and [b]The Indie Game Website[/b], they gave Across the Grooves the final score of [b]8/10[/b]!

Thanks to all the reviewers and streamers for giving us their first impressions and making our game accessible to as many people as possible!

[h2]A new Unity version for Along the Edge and Seers Isle[/h2]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/8d9f5fc1b0fbb3d895cbf41fde95f162bfb29cfc.jpg[/img]

[list]
 	[*][b]The Unity version is already available for Along the Edge and Seers Isle[/b]. To enable it, go to your Steam Library, right click the name of the game in the list, then choose “properties”, navigate to the “betas” tab and choose "Unity" in the drop-down list. The game should then update to the Unity version,[/*]
 	[*]Please note that save files are not compatible between versions, but [b]the achievements will synchronize[/b] between each version and [b]your save files (local and cloud) won’t be deleted[/b] when you switch between each version of the game,[/*]
 	[*]Soon, [b]we'll set the Unity version by default[/b] (we'll keep you informed on social networks and via Steam announcements),[/*]
 	[*]You can [b]go back to the old version[/b] if you have a save in progress and you want to finish your playthrough. To do so, once again, navigate to the “betas” tab in the properties and choose "electron" in the drop-down list and wait for the update to complete.[/*]
[/list]


That’s all for now! As always, thank you for your support! We really hope you'll enjoy your time with Alice!

notes.title: Newsletter #16 — April 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/593eb016c0823b240d8123a1810c4b40f29e6b7d.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We're still confined, but we're making good progress. We hope you're doing well too!
This month, we talk about our progress on Across the Grooves and the game's musical references!

 
[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]

Last month, we did a [b]private beta[/b] and got some [b]very cool feedback[/b]. Some testers loved it, some testers hated it, but [b]no one was left indifferent[/b]!

[b]Big thanks[/b] to the [b]testers[/b] for their involvement and for their precious feedback that allows us to make [b]better games[/b].

After the tests, we made a lot of [b]changes[/b]: improvements of the texts, the coherence of the scenario, the music…

The game’s [b]setting[/b], rather [b]obscure musical references[/b] and [b]tone of "magic realism"[/b] may cause some divided opinions, but we hope with all our hearts that you’ll be seduced by the universe, which promises to be [b]quite different[/b] from what most gamers are used to.

And lastly, we’re still moving forward. We're in the [b]polishing phase[/b], so it's starting to feel like the [b]end of production[/b]!

We're still working from home, but we're well organized and we're working hard. So we're staying the course to keep to a release in the[b] first half of 2020[/b]!
I promise, we'll tell you more soon... A little more patience! ;-)

Also, [b]Unwinnable[/b] talked about us in an article about [b]Seers Isle[/b] in the [b]Monthly Unwinnable category[/b]. Many thanks to them!

Check it out by clicking here: [url=https://unwinnable.com/2020/04/14/rowan-from-seers-isle/]Rowan from Seers Isle by Deirdre Coyle[/url]
 

[h2][b]The music in Across the Grooves[/b][/h2]

As you may know, [b]music[/b] will have a [b]major role[/b] in the game.
We've created [b]a lot of[/b] [b]songs[/b], and we can already tell you that the OST is going to sound like a [b]pop album[/b]!

We are very proud of the result and once again, we’d like to thank [b]Julien[/b] and [b]Camille[/b] for the music and sound design, [b]Christelle[/b] for lending us her beautiful voice, and [b]Charles-Henry Martin[/b] who wrote and recorded the soundtrack of Along the Edge, and who is now the pianist for Across the Grooves!

We created a [b]Spotify playlist[/b] with a mix of [b]musical references[/b] sent to the musicians for inspiration, as well as other songs and artists referenced [b]in game.[/b]

[url=https://open.spotify.com/playlist/70DcE9KfcP1dPSaCVD7r8q?si=DhsbYoFQTcaLXC_1-3CgTg]Listen to the playlist on Spotify![/url]

 
We’ve added a [b]lexicon feature[/b] in the game for those who would like to learn more about the [b]musical references[/b] of Across the Grooves.

This lexicon is not intended to replace wikipedia, but rather to be an[b] invitation to discovery [/b]for the curious. Moreover, all the entries have recommendations of records or songs to discover... Your curiosity is the only limit!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/4616072283f2a3d28f8ba5b55f716c73354eb7da.png[/img]
 
If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

And if you want to hear from us more often, you can also follow us on social networks:
http://twitter.com/novabox
http://facebook.com/novabox.studio
https://instagram.com/novabox

See you next month!
Best,

Cyndie,
on behalf on the team.

notes.title: Newsletter #15 — March 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/b98df918decfebc802e4bbc0d117d19151be78d6.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Due to the Coronavirus outbreak, the Nova-box team is working from home until further notice. But don't worry, we're doing everything we can to meet deadlines.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/97a4bcadbe4d1cccca6b409c395d410fdd772691.jpg[/img]

This month, we have some [b]exciting news[/b] to share about [b]Across the Grooves[/b]. We’ve also been working on [b]Unity versions[/b] for [b]Along the Edge[/b] and [b]Seers Isle[/b]!

[h2]What have we been up to?[/h2]

Since last month, the production of Across the Grooves has progressed well. Thus, we’re glad to announce [b]the game is officially in beta stage[/b]!

Also,[b] the[/b] [b]music has been integrated[/b] and we can tell you the songs are amazing!
[b]Camille [/b]and[b] Julien[/b] did such a great job on the music and sound design, and so did [b]Christelle[/b] on vocals!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/af5fa3bbf2a73dbdca7c20b224e73308a30a987a.jpg[/img]

Of course, we still have some images to finish, but [b]the game begins to take shape[/b] and we’re very proud of it.

Get ready for some [b]psychedelic moments[/b]!

[h2]A big update is coming soon for Along the Edge and Seers Isle[/h2]
Good news! Working on a Nintendo Switch version for Across the Grooves allowed us to build [b]Unity versions [/b]for our two other games.
[list]
 	[*]Pros:[/*]
[/list]
- [b]more stability[/b] and better overall [b]performance[/b] and [b]optimization[/b],
- [b]animations [/b](fades between images, display of text and bubbles) are [b]more fluid[/b] (60fps).
- [b]some new features added[/b], especially on Along the Edge (improved compatibility with 16/9 screens, addition of the log system, harmonization of the tutorials),
- [b]better support[/b] for gamepads,
- [b]fan-translation support[/b]. From now on, you’ll be able to translate our games into your language independently.
[list]
 	[*]Cons:[/*]
[/list]
- saves are not compatible between the current version and the Unity version, but we have a plan to make sure that it doesn't penalize players.
However, [b]unlocked achievements[/b] will remain unlocked and [b]will synchronize between the two versions[/b].

This is a screenshot of Along the Edge[b] "before"[/b] (v1.x):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/2450d72aece5a99dab2aefb298b70cb52bd87a48.jpg[/img]

And this Along the Edge [b]"after"[/b], in the upcoming Unity powered version (2.x):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/3d7d873199925bd14af5f7def1adddf44f74e431.jpg[/img]

Regarding saves, [b]we have a plan to allow players to not lose their current game[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Deployment in [b]three phases[/b]:[/*]
[/list]
- [b]phase 1[/b]: the Unity version will be available in beta on Steam, players will be able to test it if they wish (opt-in in the game properties),
- [b]phase 2[/b]: the Unity version (version 2.x) becomes the default version, but version 1.x will remain available in beta branch,
- [b]phase 3[/b]: definitive removal of version 1.x (this will happen as late as possible, but as this version will no longer be maintained, there will come a time when we’ll have to remove it because it will no longer work on most configs).Phase 1 was expected to be launched fairly quickly (by the end of the month or early April), but with COVID-19 there is a high risk of delay.

In any case, [b]we’ll keep you informed[/b] as we go along via the newsletter and specific Steam news so you have time to prepare.


If you want to subscribe to our mailing list, you can register here:
http://www.nova-box.com/signup

You'll get extra-fresh updates about our projects and our whereabouts once a month, nestled in the coziness of your own inbox (we'll never send spam, and you can unsubscribe anytime).

And if you want to hear from us more often, you can also follow us on social networks:
http://twitter.com/novabox
http://facebook.com/novabox.studio
https://instagram.com/novabox

See you next month!
Best,

Cyndie,
on behalf on the team.
